hypotheses.H1: practised token > demo token (zc_fold's token arm), exact sign test on discordant pairs
hypotheses.H2: practised token non-inferior to the one-demo LoRA (252): one-sided 95% lower bound of the pooled difference > -0.10 (two-level bootstrap)

metrics.procedure: the demo token of each task (results/robot/ftoken_<t>.pt, fitted on demo 0; ledger p1_bindings tag zc_fold: 140 of 420) practises alone (the task's instruction + the token) on init states 10-29, 20 episodes, real scene recorded; a new token is fitted on demo 0 PLUS the successful episodes (experiments/f4_fold.py --source demo+rollouts, tag _tp); a task with no practice success keeps its demo token
metrics.scoring: init states 30-49, 20 episodes per task, the same paired episodes as zc_fold
metrics.written_before: any episode of q7_p1 or q7_main
